seo_title: Sharp Story: Branding and packaging for D2C and FMCG brands
hero_heading:
Brands, cut down
to one idea.
hero_text: An independent branding and packaging studio for D2C and FMCG brands.
manifesto_text: We find the one idea your brand can own, then build the identity and packaging around it, so it reads clearly on the shelf, on screen and in the smallest quick-commerce thumbnail.

faq.q: What happens on the free call?
faq.a: We look at your brand and packaging before the call, then share three honest observations and talk through what would make the biggest difference. If there’s a fit, we follow up with a proposal.

faq.q: Can we hire you for just one service?
faq.a: Yes. You can take brand strategy, brand identity or packaging design on its own, or all three as one project.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Strategy takes 2–3 weeks, identity 4–6 weeks and packaging 3–8 weeks. A complete brand built from scratch usually takes 8–12 weeks.
Two rounds at each stage. Further rounds are quoted at a day rate.
50% to begin, 30% on route approval, 20% before final files. Prices exclude GST.
We deliver print-ready files and work with your printer on proofs.
